headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Modern Security Features
summary: Integrate real-time vulnerability scanning and binding.gyp command validation to ensure secure package installations. Incorporate user feedback mechanisms for continuous improvement. Utilize machine learning for predictive analysis of potential risks.
actions: Implement real-time vulnerability scanning using signals from open-source projects like GestaltX (8145) to check for known vulnerabilities in installed packages
Add binding.gyp command validation features to prevent malicious code execution during installations, ensuring that only safe and trusted commands are executed.
Integrate user feedback mechanisms into ClearInstall to allow users to report issues or suggest improvements, enhancing the app's adaptability and responsivenes
